title: Three Years and One Short Plan
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：site　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 site 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the planner ① chose the site that no citizen in the district would have measured, and he said the choosing was the whole of the year. The ② site, meaning the place itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a site, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ site in that district had the same short plan beside it, and the ④ site at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A site, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the planner said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the site was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the place. The ⑥ site, meaning the memory and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; site, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both a place and a memory. He said the memory is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ site had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short plan. The ⑧ site of the whole thing, the planner wrote in March, was one district and three years of measuring; site, he said, is either the plot at the far square or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ site I remember is the place measured in the report, which closed in 1966 and is still measured as the quietest in the district. A ⑩ site, my mother said in 1968, is the only place that improves by being measured; every site, she said, is a memory that has agreed to look like a place. She said the memory was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 地点；遗址（指街区里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 地点；遗址（指那处地点本身，与薄薄的图纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：choose the site 选定这一处地点
D. n. 地点；遗址（指留给孩子们丈量的那一块）
E. n. 地点之事（抽象总称，指一处街区的地点之事）
F. n. 地点；遗址（指规划报告里写到、被测量的那一处）
G. n. 地点、记忆（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 记忆（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: chose the site that no citizen in the district would have measured
The site, meaning the place itself and not the plan
the site at the far square
the site was the whole of the matter
the site had become a line in a report
The site of the whole thing
A site, my mother said in 1968

answers.why: choose the site 意为“选定这一处地点”，1959 年那位规划员把街区里没有一位市民肯测量的一处地点做了一遍。
site 意为“地点；遗址”，指那处地点本身而不是薄薄的图纸，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被测量。
site 意为“地点；遗址”，指街区里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。
site 意为“地点；遗址”，指最远那处广场的留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
site 意为“地点、记忆”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这处记忆就是那件事的全部。
site 意为“记忆”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处地点，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
site 意为“地点；遗址”，指规划报告里写到、被测量的那一处，到 1964 年这一处成了规划报告里的一行。
site 意为“地点之事”，规划员三月写道，整件事的地点之事是一处街区和三个年份的测量。
site 意为“地点；遗址”，我记得的是规划报告里测量过的那一处，1966 年落成了，至今仍被说成街区里最安静的一处。
site 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，地点是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的地点。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年那位规划员选定了街区里没有一位市民肯测量的一处地点，他说这一遍才是那个年份的全部。（choose the site）
那处地点，指的是那处地点本身而不是薄薄的图纸，经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被测量。（site）
那处街区里每一处地点旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。（site）
最远那处广场那处地点，指的是他们留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（site）
叔叔说这处记忆就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那处地点。（site）
1968 年母亲说，地点是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的地点。（site）
answers: In 1959 the planner chose the site that no citizen in the district would have measured, and he said the choosing was the whole of the year.
The site, meaning the place itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book.
Every site in that district had the same short plan beside it.
The site at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the site was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the place.
A site, my mother said in 1968, is the only place that improves by being measured.
